name: md-taskview
description: A pane showing the milestone and task tree of spec/*/tasks.md and implementation_plan.md files; press a task to tick it

specPathPattern.title: Spec path pattern
specPathPattern.description: Where spec folders are, relative to the working directory. * matches one folder level. Leave empty for the default: spec/*

taskFileNames.title: Task file names
taskFileNames.description: Comma-separated file names containing tasks inside each spec folder. For implementation_plan.md, only the tasks under its Proposed Changes heading are shown. Leave empty for the default: tasks.md, implementation_plan.md

taskFileName.title: Task file name (deprecated)
taskFileName.description: Deprecated: use Task file names. A name set here is added to that list. Leave empty.

followShellFolder.title: Follow the shell's folder
followShellFolder.description: When the project folder has no spec folders, show the tasks of the folder Claude's shell has moved to, or of the nearest folder above it that has spec folders.

followWorkingFolders.title: Follow working folders
followWorkingFolders.description: When the project folder has no spec folders, also look in the folders added with /add-dir or kept in settings, and the folders Claude reads or edits files in, most recent first, after the shell's folder.

requireReadPermission.title: Only folders Claude may read
requireReadPermission.description: Show another folder's tasks only when the session's permissions let Claude read them outright: the folder is one of the session's working folders (added with /add-dir or a permission grant), or a permission rule allows it.

stateTemplate.title: State template
stateTemplate.description: Active task state template for parsing and cycling task states.

customTemplatePath.title: Custom template path
customTemplatePath.description: Path to a custom *.jsonc state template file, used when the state template is Custom. Leave empty otherwise.

strikeThroughCompleted.title: Strike through completed
strikeThroughCompleted.description: Render completed and cancelled task labels with strikethrough styling.

animateTaskIcons.title: Animate task icons
animateTaskIcons.description: Show a rotating spinner for in-progress tasks. When off, or when Claude Code's prefersReducedMotion setting is on, a static icon is shown instead.

showProgressCount.title: Show progress count
showProgressCount.description: Display completion statistics (completed/total) on headings and spec groups.

hideCompletedByDefault.title: Hide completed by default
hideCompletedByDefault.description: Hide completed tasks when the pane first opens in a folder.

useH1AsGroupName.title: Use H1 as group name
useH1AsGroupName.description: Use the first level-1 heading in the task file as the group title instead of the folder name.

milestoneKeywords.title: Milestone keywords
milestoneKeywords.description: Comma-separated keywords that mark a heading as a milestone when the heading starts with one (any case, whole word, not plural); a keyword later in the heading does not count. Leave empty for the default: Milestone
